Off by default. Android starts the foreground VPN service after boot only after you grant VPN permission. Allow notifications to see setup alerts and the Stop action.
Always-on VPN is supported. Keep “Block connections without VPN” off because Drover routes only the selected Discord app.
VPN settings are not available on this device.

Drover uses an on-device, per-app VPN for the selected Discord installation. TCP and UDP go directly to their destinations; no Drover server is used. The tunnel sleeps while there is no traffic, but any active VPN still uses some memory and power.
